prompt:
Research the official free-tier limits of the GitHub Actions service for public and private repositories (minutes, storage, concurrency). Cite the GitHub documentation page you used.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official GitHub documentation, the limits for GitHub Actions differ significantly between public and private repositories, particularly regarding billing and minute usage. Below is a breakdown of the free-tier limits for minutes, storage, and concurrency.

### Minutes and Billing
For **public repositories**, the use of standard GitHub-hosted runners is free and unlimited. For **private repositories**, usage is subject to the monthly quotas associated with the user's or organization's GitHub plan (Free, Pro, Team, or Enterprise). Any usage beyond these quotas in private repositories is billed.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "The use of standard GitHub-hosted runners is free: In public repositories" | CLAIM: Standard runner usage is free for public repositories.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Actions usage is free for self-hosted runners and for public repositories that use standard GitHub-hosted runners." | CLAIM: Self-hosted runners are always free, and public repos using standard hosted runners are free.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "For private repositories, each GitHub account receives a quota of free minutes, artifact storage, and cache storage for use with GitHub-hosted runners, depending on the account's plan." | CLAIM: Private repositories have specific free quotas based on the plan type.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "Any usage beyond the included amounts is billed to your account." | CLAIM: Usage exceeding the plan's free quota in private repositories incurs charges.

The specific minute allowances per month for private repositories (and shared across the account/organization) are:
*   **GitHub Free / Free for organizations:** 2,000 minutes
*   **GitHub Pro / Team:** 3,000 minutes
*   **GitHub Enterprise Cloud:** 50,000 minutes

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Free | 500 MB | 2,000 | 10 GB | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: GitHub Free plan includes 2,000 free minutes per month.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Pro | 1 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: GitHub Pro plan includes 3,000 free minutes per month.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Team | 2 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB | 75 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Team plan includes 3,000 free minutes per month.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Enterprise Cloud | 50 GB | 50,000 | 10 GB | 150 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Enterprise Cloud plan includes 50,000 free minutes per month.

### Storage Limits
Storage limits apply to artifacts, caches, and custom images. Note that artifact storage is shared with GitHub Packages, while cache storage is a separate allowance per repository. GitHub Support cannot increase storage limits.

**Artifact Storage (Shared with GitHub Packages):**
*   **GitHub Free / Free for organizations:** 500 MB
*   **GitHub Pro:** 1 GB
*   **GitHub Team:** 2 GB
*   **GitHub Enterprise Cloud:** 50 GB

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "The artifact storage amounts shown are shared with GitHub Packages. This means your total storage across Actions artifacts and GitHub Packages storage cannot exceed the included amount for your plan." | CLAIM: Artifact storage limits are pooled with GitHub Packages storage.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "GitHub Support cannot increase storage limits for GitHub Actions." | CLAIM: Storage limits are fixed and cannot be increased via support tickets.

**Cache Storage (Per Repository):**
*   All plans (Free, Pro, Team, Enterprise) receive **10 GB** of cache storage per repository.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "Cache storage: Actions cache storage is a separate allowance of 10 GB per repository." | CLAIM: Each repository gets a separate 10 GB allowance for cache storage regardless of plan.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "Cache storage is not shared with artifacts or GitHub Packages." | CLAIM: Cache storage is isolated from artifact and package storage limits.

**Custom Image Storage (for Larger Runners):**
*   **GitHub Team:** 75 GB
*   **GitHub Enterprise Cloud:** 150 GB
*   **Free/Pro:** Not applicable

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Team | 2 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB | 75 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Team plan includes 75 GB of custom image storage.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Enterprise Cloud | 50 GB | 50,000 | 10 GB | 150 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Enterprise Cloud plan includes 150 GB of custom image storage.

### Concurrency and Rate Limits
Concurrency limits refer to the number of jobs that can run simultaneously. These limits depend on the runner type and the GitHub plan. Additionally, there are rate limits for triggering workflows.

**Job Concurrency Limits (GitHub-hosted runners):**
*   **Free Plan:** 20 concurrent jobs (max 5 macOS)
*   **Pro Plan:** 40 concurrent jobs (max 5 macOS)
*   **Team Plan:** 60 concurrent jobs (max 5 macOS) for standard runners; 1000 for larger runners.
*   **Enterprise Plan:** 500 concurrent jobs (max 50 macOS) for standard runners; 1000 for larger runners.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Free | 20 | 5 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: The Free plan allows 20 total concurrent jobs on standard runners, with a maximum of 5 macOS jobs.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Pro | 40 | 5 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: The Pro plan allows 40 total concurrent jobs on standard runners, with a maximum of 5 macOS jobs.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Team | 60 | 5 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: The Team plan allows 60 total concurrent jobs on standard runners, with a maximum of 5 macOS jobs.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Enterprise | 500 | 50 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: The Enterprise plan allows 500 total concurrent jobs on standard runners, with a maximum of 50 macOS jobs.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "The maximum concurrent macOS jobs is shared across standard GitHub-hosted runners and GitHub-hosted larger runners." | CLAIM: macOS concurrency limits are pooled across standard and larger runner types.

**Workflow Trigger and Queuing Limits:**
*   **Trigger Event Rate:** 1,500 events per 10 seconds per repository.
*   **Queued Workflow Runs:** 500 workflow runs per 10 seconds.
*   **Concurrency Group Queue:** Up to 100 workflow runs per concurrency group (when using `queue: max`).
*   **Check Runs:** Maximum 50,000 check runs per check suite.

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "Each repository is limited to events triggering a workflow run. ... 1500 events / 10 seconds / repository" | CLAIM: Repositories are limited to 1,500 workflow trigger events every 10 seconds.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "500 workflow runs / 10 seconds" | CLAIM: A maximum of 500 workflow runs can be queued every 10 seconds.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "When using `queue: max` in the `concurrency` section, up to 100 workflow runs / concurrency group" | CLAIM: Concurrency groups can queue up to 100 workflow runs.
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "A check suite can have a maximum of 50,000 check runs." | CLAIM: A single check suite is limited to 50,000 check runs.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Specific concurrency limits for self-hosted runners (as they are determined by the user's own infrastructure).
